description: Return Musicwire's free MusicXML authoring prompt and quality bar. Use this first, before validate or render, to learn what the QC gate accepts. Does not compose music, does not charge, and needs no Payment-Signature. Optional style, use, duration, key, tempo, and edit flags only shape the prompt text.

duration.description: Optional target duration in plain language, for example 45-60 seconds.

edit.description: When true, the prompt asks to edit supplied MusicXML conservatively instead of composing from scratch.

key.description: Optional concert key, for example F major.

style.description: Optional style for the prompt, for example waltz or jazz combo.

tempo.description: Optional tempo marking or BPM, for example 84.

use.description: Optional intended use, for example restaurant background or study.

name: musicwire_compose_guide
title: Compose guide
